instruction: versions.txt has one semver per line. Write sort.py emitting sorted.txt ordered by semver precedence (numeric compare of major.minor.patch; ignore pre-release suffixes — treat 1.2.3-rc1 as 1.2.3). Run it.

oracle.script:
cat > sort.py <<'EOF'
def key(v):
    core = v.split('-')[0]
    return tuple(int(x) for x in core.split('.'))
vs = open('versions.txt').read().split()
vs.sort(key=lambda v: (key(v), '-rc' in v))
open('sorted.txt','w').write('\n'.join(vs) + '\n')
EOF
python3 sort.py
